unit.why: A single anecdote: the Maggid of Kozienice in Brody stops at a house and senses the impurity of a place where the Toldot Yaakov Yosef had been burned.

stories.start_quote: וכאשר עיני ראו בהיות הה״ק אאמו״ר
stories.summary_en: While passing through Brody, the Maggid of Kozienice stops at a house and says he cannot bear its impurity. Inquiry shows that the book Toldot Yaakov Yosef had once been burned on that spot.

quotes: כי לא יוכל לסבול טומאת הבית הזה
tags.why: he supernaturally senses the impurity of the place

quotes: שרפו זה זמן ספרי תולדות יעקב יוסף
tags.why: burning of Hasidic books by opponents (mitnagdim)

quotes: ואחר החקירה והדרישה נתוודע כי במקום הזה
tags.why: the meaning of his reaction is understood only after inquiry

quotes: ומדי עברו אצל הבתים למחוז חפצו
tags.why: the tzaddik is passing through Brody on his way

quotes: שרפו זה זמן ספרי תולדות יעקב יוסף רח״ל

tags.why: the narrator (author of the source) is the son of the tzaddik and was an eyewitness
